responsibility: This makefile fragment integrates the Rust frontend into GCC's top-level build system. It declares how to build the `rust1` compiler proper and `gccrs` driver, enumerates the Rust frontend object files and include paths, wires Rust-specific warning flags, install and uninstall hooks, bootstrap stage movement, and selftest targets, and thereby controls how the `gcc/rust` sources are compiled and linked into GCC executables.
